title: COP31 Closes Without a Main Pact as Other Climate Work Moves Forward

sources.name: UNFCCC

sources.title: COP31 Outcomes - your questions answered

sources.name: United Nations in Türkiye
sources.title: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’

paragraphs.en: The COP31 climate conference closed
paragraphs.zh: COP31氣候會議閉幕了，

paragraphs.en: in Antalya, Turkey, on November 22, 2026,
paragraphs.zh: 地點在土耳其安塔利亞，日期是2026年11月22日，

paragraphs.en: without agreement on its overall political pact.
paragraphs.zh: 各方未能就整體政治協定達成共識。

paragraphs.en: Negotiations had continued beyond the original schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 談判持續的時間超過原訂日程。

paragraphs.en: UN officials expressed deep disappointment over the result,
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國官員對結果表達深切失望，

paragraphs.en: but officials also highlighted progress
paragraphs.zh: 但官員也強調了其他進展，

paragraphs.en: on other decisions and practical initiatives.
paragraphs.zh: 涵蓋其他決議與實務倡議。

paragraphs.en: The outcome was therefore complex.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這次會議的結果相當複雜。

paragraphs.en: Disagreement centred on fossil fuels
paragraphs.zh: 分歧集中在化石燃料，

paragraphs.en: and how to move away from them.
paragraphs.zh: 以及該如何逐步轉型、不再依賴它們。

paragraphs.en: The UN's account described divisions
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國的報導描述了各方分歧，

paragraphs.en: between countries seeking stronger action
paragraphs.zh: 一方是要求更強力行動的國家，

paragraphs.en: and economies heavily dependent on fuel exports.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方則是高度依賴燃料出口的經濟體。

paragraphs.en: Several delegations objected to the proposed text.
paragraphs.zh: 數個代表團反對這份提議中的文本。

paragraphs.en: The final compromise did not win the support
paragraphs.zh: 最終折衷方案未能贏得支持，

paragraphs.en: needed for the overarching decision.
paragraphs.zh: 因此無法通過整體決議。

paragraphs.en: The UN Secretary-General said the lack of agreement
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國秘書長表示，未能達成協議

paragraphs.en: did not change the scientific reality.
paragraphs.zh: 並沒有改變科學事實。

paragraphs.en: He called for deeper emissions cuts,
paragraphs.zh: 他呼籲更大幅度削減排放、

paragraphs.en: more support for vulnerable countries,
paragraphs.zh: 增加對脆弱國家的支援，

paragraphs.en: and greater funding to adapt to climate impacts.
paragraphs.zh: 以及投入更多資金，調適氣候變遷帶來的影響。

paragraphs.en: His response shifted attention
paragraphs.zh: 他的回應將注意力

paragraphs.en: from the negotiating room to action
paragraphs.zh: 從談判會場轉向實際行動，

paragraphs.en: in energy systems, forests, and communities.
paragraphs.zh: 涵蓋能源系統、森林與社區。

paragraphs.en: Political deadlock had not removed those needs.
paragraphs.zh: 政治僵局並未讓這些需求消失。

paragraphs.en: In his closing remarks, UN climate chief Simon Stiell
paragraphs.zh: 聯合國氣候事務主管西蒙・斯蒂爾在閉幕致詞中，

paragraphs.en: acknowledged the setback while identifying other progress.
paragraphs.zh: 承認這次挫折，也指出其他方面的進展。

paragraphs.en: He highlighted a decision on a just transition,
paragraphs.zh: 他強調了一項關於公正轉型的決議，

paragraphs.en: connecting it with fairness and inclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 並將其與公平及包容連結起來。

paragraphs.en: He also urged greater transparency
paragraphs.zh: 他也呼籲提高透明度，

paragraphs.en: and careful listening in building consensus.
paragraphs.zh: 在建立共識時仔細聽取各方意見。

paragraphs.en: His message combined criticism of the result
paragraphs.zh: 他的訊息既批評了這次結果，

paragraphs.en: with support for continued international cooperation.
paragraphs.zh: 也支持國際合作繼續進行。

paragraphs.en: Stiell described a second track
paragraphs.zh: 斯蒂爾描述了另一條工作路線，

paragraphs.en: beyond formal negotiating decisions: the Action Agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 除了正式談判決議之外，還有「行動議程」。

paragraphs.en: It covered areas including agriculture, food systems,
paragraphs.zh: 它涵蓋農業、糧食系統等領域，

paragraphs.en: and resilience in cities and infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 也包括城市與基礎設施的韌性。

paragraphs.en: He also pointed to electrification pledges
paragraphs.zh: 他也提到電氣化承諾，

paragraphs.en: and a delivery package supporting that effort.
paragraphs.zh: 以及支援這項工作的執行方案。

paragraphs.en: These initiatives involve practical work
paragraphs.zh: 這些倡議涉及實務工作，

paragraphs.en: that can continue alongside the negotiations.
paragraphs.zh: 可以與談判同時持續推進。

paragraphs.en: They do not replace the need for shared political agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 它們並不能取代共同政治協議的必要性。

paragraphs.en: The UK government published its own explanation
paragraphs.zh: 英國政府發布了自己的說明，

paragraphs.en: on November 22.
paragraphs.zh: 日期同樣是11月22日。

paragraphs.en: It reported progress on climate finance
paragraphs.zh: 其中提到氣候資金方面的進展，

paragraphs.en: and voluntary commitments in several areas.
paragraphs.zh: 以及數個領域的自願性承諾。

paragraphs.en: Examples included cleaner energy, methane reductions,
paragraphs.zh: 例如較潔淨的能源、減少甲烷排放、

paragraphs.en: forest and ocean protection, and early-warning systems.
paragraphs.zh: 保護森林與海洋，以及預警系統。

paragraphs.en: The government's account distinguishes these developments
paragraphs.zh: 政府的說明將這些進展

paragraphs.en: from the failure to agree on the Antalya Pact.
paragraphs.zh: 與未能就《安塔利亞協定》達成共識一事區分開來。

paragraphs.en: Both belong in a description of the conference.
paragraphs.zh: 描述這次會議時，兩者都應納入。

paragraphs.en: The Paris Agreement remains in place,
paragraphs.zh: 《巴黎協定》仍然有效，

paragraphs.en: the UK explanation stressed.
paragraphs.zh: 英國的說明如此強調。

paragraphs.en: Existing commitments still stand.
paragraphs.zh: 既有承諾仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: Failure to adopt one new pact
paragraphs.zh: 未能通過一份新的協定，

paragraphs.en: does not erase earlier agreements.
paragraphs.zh: 並不會抹去先前的協議。

paragraphs.en: This distinction helps explain why countries
paragraphs.zh: 這項區別有助於理解，為何各國

paragraphs.en: can express disappointment with a summit
paragraphs.zh: 可以對一場峰會表示失望，

paragraphs.en: while remaining committed to the wider process.
paragraphs.zh: 同時仍致力於更廣泛的合作進程。

paragraphs.en: There is still work to carry out between conferences.
paragraphs.zh: 各次會議之間，仍然有工作需要落實。

paragraphs.en: Attention now turns to COP32 in Ethiopia.
paragraphs.zh: 現在，焦點轉向將在衣索比亞舉行的COP32。

paragraphs.en: Governments will return to unresolved questions
paragraphs.zh: 各國政府將重新面對尚未解決的問題，

paragraphs.en: about energy transitions and support for developing countries.
paragraphs.zh: 包括能源轉型，以及對開發中國家的支援。

paragraphs.en: The immediate challenge is to connect
paragraphs.zh: 眼前的挑戰，是將

paragraphs.en: continued cooperation with credible delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 持續合作與可信的執行成果連結起來。

paragraphs.en: The closing statements point towards two needs:
paragraphs.zh: 閉幕聲明指向兩項需求：

paragraphs.en: better ways to reach collective decisions
paragraphs.zh: 以更好的方式達成集體決議，

paragraphs.en: and stronger implementation of commitments already made.
paragraphs.zh: 以及更有力地落實已作出的承諾。

account.meaning: 報導、說明；文中指聯合國或英國政府對會議的說明

away.meaning: 離開；move away from指逐步轉離或降低對某事物的依賴

belong.meaning: 應納入、屬於；belong in指應列入某個範圍

centred.meaning: 集中、聚焦；centred on指集中在

continued.meaning: 持續進行；也可作形容詞表示持續的

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the article?

choices.text: COP31 reached agreement on every political issue and completed all climate work.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第一與第二段指出整體政治協定未達共識，最後一段也有尚未解決的問題。

choices.text: COP31 failed to agree on its main pact, while other decisions and initiatives still made progress.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段同時提出協定未達共識與其他成果，第四至第六段具體說明這些進展。

choices.text: The conference ended every previous international climate commitment.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段強調《巴黎協定》及既有承諾仍然存在。

choices.text: The conference focused only on choosing a location for COP32.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章涵蓋化石燃料、轉型、資金及行動議程等內容，並非只選下次會議地點。

quiz.explanation: 主旨需要同時保留主要政治協定失敗與其他部分有進展這兩個面向。用「所有工作成功」或「所有工作消失」概括，都超出文章內容。

evidence.quote: UN officials expressed deep disappointment over the result, but officials also highlighted progress on other decisions and practical initiatives.
The government's account distinguishes these developments from the failure to agree on the Antalya Pact.

quiz.question: What can reasonably be inferred about earlier climate commitments after COP31?

choices.text: They apply only if every later summit adopts a new main pact.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段說明未能通過新協定，不會抹去早先協議。

choices.text: They were replaced entirely by electrification pledges.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段說行動倡議不能取代共同政治協議，第七段也保留既有承諾。

choices.text: They no longer require any work between conferences.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七與第八段均說明會議之間仍須落實工作。

choices.text: They remain relevant, and countries still need to implement them despite the setback.
choices.explanation: 正確。第七段保留既有承諾，第八段要求更有力地落實已作出的承諾。

quiz.explanation: 一次峰會未達成新的整體協定，不等於先前承諾自動失效。文章將協定延續與執行責任連結，支持繼續落實既有工作的推論。

evidence.quote: Existing commitments still stand. Failure to adopt one new pact does not erase earlier agreements.
The closing statements point towards two needs: better ways to reach collective decisions and stronger implementation of commitments already made.

quiz.question: How does the Action Agenda relate to the formal negotiating process?

choices.text: It offers another track for practical work that can continue, while shared political agreement remains necessary.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段將它描述為第二條路線，能與談判並行，也明說它不取代共同政治協議的必要性。

choices.text: It makes transparency and listening in negotiations unnecessary.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段提到提高透明度與聽取意見，並未因行動議程而取消。

choices.text: It proves that all countries accepted the final compromise text.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段指出折衷文本未獲所需支持，行動議程的進展不等於接受政治文本。

choices.text: It prevents work on agriculture, food systems, and city resilience.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段將這些領域列為行動議程涵蓋的內容。

quiz.explanation: 文章區分正式談判與實務倡議，並說明兩條路線可以並行。行動議程的成果有其意義，但不能用來推論政治共識已經達成或不再必要。

evidence.quote: He also urged greater transparency and careful listening in building consensus.
These initiatives involve practical work that can continue alongside the negotiations. They do not replace the need for shared political agreement.
